chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Abu Kahmas, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'Abdullah ibn Abi Yafur conveys the greetings to you.' He said, 'And upon you and him be the greetings. When you go to Abdullah, convey the greetings to him and say to him that Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) says to you: 'Look at what Ali (peace be upon him) reached in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), so adhere to it, for indeed Ali (peace be upon him) reached whatever he reached in the presence of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) by truthful narration and the fulfillment of the trust.'

key_terms.عَلِيٌّ ( عليه السلام ): Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What are the two key virtues that led to Imam Ali's high status among the companions of the Prophet?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links the preservation of authentic hadith to the exemplary conduct of Imam Ali (peace be upon him), emphasizing that his elevated status was achieved through 'sidq al-hadith' (truthfulness in narration) and 'ada' al-amanah' (fulfillment of trust). This hadith serves as a foundational principle in Shia epistemology, asserting that the reliability of religious knowledge depends on the moral integrity and trustworthiness of its transmitters, mirroring the Prophet's confidence in Ali.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Abu Kahmasy who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, ‘Abdullah Bin Abu Yafour conveys the greetings to you<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>’. So he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘And upon him be the greetings. When you go to Abdullah, so convey the greetings and say to him that Ja’far<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> Bin Muhammad<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> is saying to you: ‘Look at what Ali<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> reached with in the presence of Rasool-Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup>, so necessitate it, for Ali<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, rather, reached whatever he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> reached with in the presence of Rasool-Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> by truthful narrations and repayment of the entrustments’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Hassan ibn Mahbub from abu Kahmas who has said the following:

“Once I said to abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) “Abd Allah ibn abu Ya’fur has sent you ( salam ) greetings.’ The Imam said, ‘May salam (peace) be with you and with him. If you meet ‘Abd Allah convey salam to him and say, ‘Ja’far, son of Muhammad, says to you, “Consider to what level Ali (Amir al-Mu’minin ibn abu Talib) had reached before the Messenger of Allah. You must follow his manners. Ali (a.s.) reached the level that he reached before the Messenger of Allah because of the truthfulness in his words and his trustworthiness in returning the trust.’””
